customer.pageTitleObserved: 2K Games – Official Website for 2K | Basketball Video Games | NBA 2K
customer.notice: Internal Google Cloud EBC demonstration use only. Extracted from public web properties (https://2k.com, https://nba.2k.com, https://www.take2games.com) and repository design system (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, src/app/globals.css, tailwind.config.js).

auditNotes: Primary 2K red token (--twok-red: #EA2228) is extracted directly from public/brands/2k/2k-logo.svg and aligns with 2k.com (--av-accent-primary: #E61F27 / meta theme-color #EB1C26) and nba.2k.com (#EC1C23).

Minor token drift detected in 4 component files (SeasonJourneySankey.tsx, ActivationDAG.tsx, LiveTelemetryTicker.tsx, NBAMarketMap.tsx) which hardcode #E4002B instead of referencing var(--twok-red) / text-twok-red (#EA2228).

typography.numericDiscipline: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums mandatory on all live counts, VC figures, latencies, and countdowns (.tabular, .font-mono)

geometry.spacingDensity: broadcast-arena-dense (14px-16px panel padding, 16px-24px section gap, full-viewport workspace with floating glass drawers)
geometry.borderWidth: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) with 1px top specular highlight gradient

patterns.buttonStyle: Solid 2K Red (#EA2228) primary CTA with uppercase JetBrains Mono tracking-wider 600 weight, scale(0.97) on :active (120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), zero neon drop-shadow glow; HoldToConfirm 1.4s linear clip-path fill for live campaign dispatch
patterns.navPattern: Top broadcast bar with BrandLockup (/brands/2k/2k-logo.svg + Courtside + NBA 2K27 badge) on left, segmented workspace view switcher center, live TakeTwoPlayerGraph status pill and action triggers right
patterns.photoStyle: Dark broadcast NBA arena at night, maple hardwood court grain at 7% screen blend (/brands/2k/art/hardwood-texture.webp), authentic NBA 2K27 MyTEAM Galaxy Opal pack key art, Crew Re-Up courtside photography, and Vice City / hardwood cross-label key visuals
patterns.logoUsage: Official vector 2K mark (/brands/2k/2k-logo.svg) in a subtle 2K Red tinted badge container, paired with Take-Two label chips (2K #EA2228, Rockstar #FCAF17, Zynga #2F6FED)
patterns.surfacePosture: Dark-first arena broadcast mode (--court-black #0A0A0C canvas, --court-ink #121216 elevated panels, .glass backdrop-blur(20px) and .glass-heavy backdrop-blur(28px), never stacking two .glass layers directly)
